notes: The gap-fill slices described sectors in free text. Each is mapped here onto the fixed sector list. Precedents: Finastra, PayPal and Visa are Fintech, so banking-software vendors and payment networks are too. Mu Sigma is Consulting & professional services, so analytics service firms are too. Livspace and NoBroker are Real estate & infrastructure, so home-interiors and proptech apps are too. D2C brands follow BlueStone into Retail & consumer goods, 3M and Honeywell put industrial chemicals and building technology under Automotive & industrial, and petrochemicals and utilities follow Shell into Energy. The file name sorts last, so it applies after every verification pass.
